title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.
required_documents: Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in)
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmers Corner
Enter Aadhaar number and select state to verify records
Fill in land details and submit with bank IFSC code

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
summary: Financial assistance of up to Rs. 1.20 lakh (plains) or Rs. 1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for pucca house construction for rural homeless and kutcha-house dwellers.
required_documents: Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) Toilet verification number
application_steps: Contact the local Gram Panchayat or Block Development Officer (BDO)
Verification is conducted using the Awaas+ portal database
Geo-tagging of the existing site is done by the Gram Rozgar Sahayak
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) installments are disbursed in stages directly to the bank account

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry_or_dept: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Health insurance cover of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empaneled public and private hospitals.
required_documents: Proof of family identity (Family ID / Ration Card)
application_steps: Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in or call toll-free 14555
Visit any empaneled hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC)
Carry Aadhaar and Ration Card for biometric e-KYC
Receive digital Ayushman Card on the spot

title: National Scholarship Portal - Pre & Post Matric Scholarships
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Minority Affairs / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
summary: Financial support covering tuition fees and maintenance allowance for school and college students from economically weaker sections and reserved categories.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Enrolment Slip
Income Certificate issued by competent Revenue authority (Tehsildar / SDO)
Current Academic Marksheet and Bonafide Student Certificate
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR (One Time Registration)
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC using Face Auth or Biometric
Select applicable scholarship scheme based on caste, class, and family income
Upload documents and submit; track status via Institute Verification

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Collateral-free working capital micro-loans of Rs. 10,000 (1st tranche), Rs. 20,000 (2nd tranche), and Rs. 50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy for urban street vendors.
required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Urban Local Body (ULB)
application_steps: Check vending eligibility on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or contact the local Municipal Corporation / Municipality
Obtain Letter of Recommendation (LoR) if Certificate of Vending is not held
Apply online directly or through the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Lending institution credits loan amount directly to bank account

title: Voter ID Registration & Correction (Form 6)
summary: Registration of new electors on attaining 18 years of age, or updating constituency details upon relocation across India.
required_documents: Proof of Age (Birth Certificate / Aadhaar / PAN / Class 10 Certificate)
Proof of Residence (Water/Electricity bill / Aadhaar / Ration Card / Bank Passbook)
application_steps: Open the official ECI Voters portal (voters.eci.gov.in) or Voter Helpline App
Sign up with mobile number and select Form 6 (New Voter Registration)
Fill in personal details, assembly constituency, and address
Upload age and address proofs and submit to generate Reference Tracking Number
Booth Level Officer (BLO) performs field verification; EPIC card delivered via Speed Post

title: MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship Schemes
ministry_or_dept: Government of Maharashtra (Social Justice & Special Assistance)
summary: Post-matric scholarship and freeship schemes for SC, ST, VJNT, OBC, and SEBC students studying in recognized colleges and universities in Maharashtra.
required_documents: College Admission Fee Receipt & CAP Allotment Letter
application_steps: Register on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in using Aadhaar authentication
Create profile and fill in personal, address, other, and current course details
Select department and apply for corresponding Post-Matric Scholarship
Submit application for college verification and scrutiny

title: DigiLocker National Digital Document Wallet
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
summary: Official cloud repository for issued digital documents like Aadhaar, Driving License, Vehicle RC, Marksheets, and Ration Cards having legal parity with original physical documents under Rule 9A of the IT Rules.
required_documents: Mobile number linked to Aadhaar for OTP
application_steps: Visit digilocker.gov.in or install the official DigiLocker app
Click Sign Up and enter Aadhaar number with date of birth
Verify OTP sent to Aadhaar-registered mobile
Search for any state or central issuing authority to fetch verified document directly
